## Objective and upstream reuse
Describe user-visible capability and which existing open-source tools or system APIs were reused.

## Evidence and security
- [ ] Tested Python unittest + build locally or CI
- [ ] GitHub-hosted Linux check passed
- [ ] GitHub-hosted Windows check passed
- [ ] CodeQL / relevant security checks passed
- [ ] No credential, signing key, private app source, or unverified release link included
- [ ] Self-hosted runner never processed untrusted PR code
- [ ] Signed APK / Windows Authenticode and real-device status accurately stated
- [ ] AGENTS.md / ENGINEERING-STATE.md / NEXT-EXECUTION.md updated if scope or acceptance changed

## Acceptance
Link exact commit and checks, real device test run if applicable. Identify remaining blockers rather than claiming production-ready from mocked tests.
